definitions.explanation: Completely forgetting something, or the state of having been forgotten. A literary and formal word that carries a heavier nuance than simply forgetting — it suggests something has faded entirely from memory.

examples.japanese: ⟦{過去|かこ}→過去：00152_kako⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{忘却|ぼうきゃく}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: To consign the past to oblivion.

examples.japanese: ⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧⟦{事件|じけん}→事件：01568_jiken⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{忘却|ぼうきゃく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{彼方|かなた}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: That incident has faded into the depths of oblivion.

examples.japanese: ⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{経|た}てば→経つ：09892_tatsu⟧、⟦{辛|つら}い→辛い：01112_tsurai⟧⟦{記憶|きおく}→記憶：00234_kioku⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{忘却|ぼうきゃく}⟦されて→する：00392_suru⟧いくものだ。
examples.english: With the passage of time, even painful memories fade into oblivion.

notes:
A formal, literary word. Much weightier than ⟦{忘|わす}れる→忘れる：00474_wasureru⟧ (to forget), which is the everyday term. {忘却|ぼうきゃく} implies complete erasure from memory.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {忘却|ぼうきゃく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{彼方|かなた} — beyond the reach of memory; deep in oblivion
- {忘却|ぼうきゃく}⟦{曲線|きょくせん}→曲線：05441_kyokusen⟧ — forgetting curve (psychology term)
- {忘却|ぼうきゃく}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ — to forget completely (⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ verb)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{忘|わす}れる→忘れる：00474_wasureru⟧ — to forget (everyday, neutral)
- ⟦{失念|しつねん}→失念：16319_shitsunen⟧ — to slip one's mind (polite/humble, used in business)
- ⟦{健忘|けんぼう}→健忘：17110_kenbou⟧ — forgetfulness (medical/clinical term)
